name: pr-2687
title: PR #2687 — #2603 b1 + b2: a free vector the figure defines, a free letter scaling a free vector (3-D)

cases.title: A free letter scales a free vector
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». All three lines build; E is drawn on the line through A along p. Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: both p and E move.

cases.title: A free vector the figure defines spans a point
lines: P על AM כך ש-KP = αu + βv
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». Every line builds and P is drawn on AM where KB crosses it, the same place as when the vectors are named with «נסמן: AA' = w, KC = v, KB = u».

cases.title: REFUSAL — a cube edge as a multiple of an undefined vector
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». «AD = k·p» is refused as the tool's limit (an undefined free vector cannot carry a cube edge yet; stage b3, #2684).
